evidence.convention_status: Craig modified DH with a[1]=37.5 includes the newly measured shoulder offset. Geometric zero and motor sign convention preserve prior user-confirmed standard posture and directions; CAD residuals are not absorbed into nominal link dimensions.

parameter_confirmation.geometry_confirmation_method: User requested reconstruction using the supplied actual CAD assembly and parts (2026-10-03).
parameter_confirmation.ratio_confirmation_method: User confirmed installed reducers and small driving gears / large driven gears; joint 6 direct motor output.
parameter_confirmation.motor_settings_confirmation_method: User explicitly confirmed all motors use 1.8 degree step angle and 16 microsteps.
parameter_confirmation.continuous_joints_confirmation_method: User explicitly stated: joint 6 has no limit (2026-10-03).
parameter_confirmation.standard_zero_confirmation_method: User confirmed on 2026-10-04 that shutdown returns to standard zero and the initial power-on position is the standard zero. Runtime feedback and session provenance are validated separately.
parameter_confirmation.directions_confirmation_method: User explicitly confirmed all six physical directions match the original reference.
parameter_confirmation.endpoint_selection_method: Explicitly stated implementation default; external tool TCP remains unconfigured.

pulses_per_rev_verification.applies_to: Emm firmware FD / FC pulse-position commands

execution.zero_binding_policy: The user-approved standard zero is the power-on position after a successful console return-to-zero shutdown. Automatically bind only a complete, healthy six-axis power-on zero session. Preserve the same verified zero across console restarts in the same boot. Manual zero changes invalidate automatic Cartesian binding. Do not carry historical boot/session bindings in this model.
